name: BRONZE_SERPENT_STANDARD
canonical: a single cast-bronze serpent SET UPON THE VERY TOP of a tall straight BARE wooden pole, its bronze body and head lifted high like a banner; the long lower shaft is plain bare wood and the serpent does NOT coil, spiral, wind or wrap around the pole — NOT a snake-wound staff, NOT a caduceus or Rod of Asclepius, NOT a spear-tip or flag/banner-topped standard, planted upright in the wilderness ground — a serpent set upon a pole for all the people to look upon
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
